svg.title: Workflow: Cloud managed-services support transformation
svg.desc: Solution workflow (hybrid) for Cloud managed-services support transformation: 1 trigger: Ticket arrives by email, portal, team chat or legacy-ticket sync, or a correlated alert incident arrives by webhook → ticket or incident created; 2 workflow: Fires once on creation and calls the main agent → one AI action; 3 agent: Scans for P1/P2 emergency signals, classifies type, category, priority → structured output; 4 decision: P1/P2 or change request? yes → step 5 / no → step 6; 5 guardrail: No AI reply; route to on-call queue or approval board → human-only handling; 6 skill: Searches KB and runbooks; for alerts, graph lookup and on-demand cloud log and metric pulls → grounded context; 7 agent: Drafts the reply or customer notification and SOP checklist, or NO_RESPONSE → draft; 8 human: Reviews, personalises and approves send (100% on customer-impacting actions; supervised mode early on) → sent communication; 9 workflow: Awaiting-requester stage then auto-resolve and close after N days of silence; incident resolution closes linked tickets → closed records; 10 outcome: Alert-to-customer notice and human touch-time under 5 minutes (target) → more customers per team
